entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker. It's broken.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I get you to the right place, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault?
Yes, it's not working. I've had it for about eleven days and it just won't sync with my phone anymore. It's useless.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the sync feature. That's definitely frustrating. When you say it's not working, does the device power on at all?
It powers on, but that's it. It won't sync. I think the Bluetooth is defective. So, can I get a return or not?
I understand you want a direct answer. Since the issue sounds like a technical one and you're just past the 10-day return window, the required next step is to connect you with our Tech Support team.
I don't have time to troubleshoot. The product is defective. I want to send it back.

I completely understand. The reason for the transfer is that our Tech Support team is equipped to diagnose if the band is truly broken. If they confirm it's a defective unit, they are the ones who can authorize a replacement or a return for you right away. It's actually the fastest path to a solution for this specific problem.
Fine. If it's the fastest way, then do it. Just transfer me now.
Of course. I'll connect you right over to them. They'll have all your information. Please hold for one moment.
